name: Parting List
description: A list you reorder by carrying a row through it while the other rows part round it in a wave and close behind it.

props.name: items
props.description: The rows, in order. Each needs a stable id (a string or a number) that survives reordering.

props.name: onReorder
props.description: Called once when a row is dropped in a new place, with the items in their new order. Pass them back as items. If the new order is not taken up, the rows glide back.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Draws a row's content beside its grip. dragging is true while the row is carried by pointer or keyboard.

props.name: itemLabel
props.default: the item's label, name or title, else its id
props.description: Names a row for its grip button ("Move Hakuba") and for the announcements made as it moves ("Hakuba, position 2 of 6").

props.name: variant
props.description: Separate cards with a gap between them, or rows inside one card with a hairline between each.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the list. Use this or aria-labelledby.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of a heading that names the list.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper around the list. Other props are spread onto it too.
